name: easypass-dev-tools
description: Root-level dev-only dependencies for the EasyPass tooling that is written in Node.js (the jsdom browser-extension smoke tests). The Flutter app itself has no Node.js dependency; `flutter pub get` remains the only install step it needs.

scripts.test:extension: npm run check:extension && npm run smoke:content && npm run smoke:popup && npm run smoke:popup-extra
